name: the opt-in gate never stops the script
why: brucespringsteen.it support is opt-in (sa_enable_brucespringsteen, default off). Without the gate the script puts its toolbar on the site's page and ticks its form with the setting off.
grep: with the setting off

name: the frame gate never stops the script
why: records.aspx is normally the 222 px left frame of Blegsdx.htm, and the header has no @noframes. Without the frame gate the script injects its toolbar there and ticks the frame's form.
grep: inside the Blegsdx.htm frameset

name: no <h1> is injected for the toolbar
why: The page has no heading; without the injected <h1> the init block stops at the required-elements check and neither button is offered.
grep: with the setting on

name: the form's format boxes are not ticked at init
why: The org file asks for every checkbox to be ticked before a button is pressed; the frameset's default list ticks Vinyl LP alone.
grep: with the setting on

name: no second tick after the site's own onload
why: Tampermonkey's document-idle can come before the page's onload="setup(...)", which unticks the boxes again; the load listener re-ticks them. The fixture harness injects the script AFTER load (readyState is already 'complete', so the listener is never added), so no fixture spec can order the two: recorded honestly as invisible. Checked by hand in a real browser instead.
grep: with the setting on

name: the pressed kind is not ticked at click time
why: At click time the form is made to show what is fetched, including the Unofficial/Official radio; without it the radio stays on the page's own kind.
grep: every official record of every format

name: the fetched page is not converted
why: Both buttons FETCH page 1; its records are the table's rows. Without the pagination-loop call site the fetched document has no table.tbl and the render has nothing to show.
grep: every unofficial record of every format

name: the live page gets no table to render into
why: renderFinalTable() needs a table.tbl tbody in the live DOM; the site has none. Without the click-time conversion the render aborts.
grep: every unofficial record of every format

name: the live page's own records stay under the table
why: The live page lists its own filter's records (the LP list); they must go once the table takes their place.
grep: every unofficial record of every format

name: the extra max-page request is made
why: Without non_paginated, button params send the fetch through fetchMaxPageGeneric(), which loads the same 250 KB page once more only to find no pagination.
grep: every unofficial record of every format

name: the Official button carries the unofficial kind
why: The kind picks both the fetched list (tipe=-2) and the column set; the official columns must follow the button.
grep: every official record of every format

name: the Official button fetches the unofficial list
why: tipe=-2 is what makes the server list official records.
grep: every official record of every format

name: PROMO is left in the country
why: An official promo's head ends in a PROMO span; without the split the Country cell reads 'Germany) PROMO'-like text and Promo is never 'yes'.
grep: country, catalogue number, promo flag

name: the format runs to the LAST parenthesis
why: A label with its own parentheses ('UPC (?)') must stay whole; a greedy format group splits at its inner '('.

name: 'Mx : ' with spaces is not read
why: The site writes both 'Mx:' and 'Mx : ' (378 of 1876), and 'Catalogue:' and 'Catalogue : '.
grep: record fields land in their own columns

name: the Title link keeps the site's base target
why: Standalone there is no 'principale' frame; the page's <base target> would open each record in a window of that name. The spec pins target=_blank.
grep: record fields land in their own columns

name: the navigation guard ignores the query on brucespringsteen.it
why: Every list is records.aspx?tipe=...; comparing the path only, a predefined-filter link would drop a loaded table without asking.
grep: predefined-filter link

name: Load from Disk does not convert (no base feature)
why: Load from Disk runs with the base definition, not a button's; without bsRecordsToTable there the fresh page's records stay and the table is fabricated elsewhere.
grep: a reopened Official list

name: the converter is not called on Load from Disk
why: After a reload the live page holds the site's record paragraphs again.
grep: a reopened Official list

name: the shared table look is not installed on brucespringsteen.it
why: The site has no MusicBrainz CSS; without _ensureForeignTableStyle() the table has no borders or padding.
grep: every unofficial record of every format

name: the @include line is missing
why: Tampermonkey would never inject the script on records.aspx; only the regex spec can see it.
